        int totalChars = Integer.parseInt(scanner.nextLine());
        String inputLine = scanner.nextLine();

        int totalWordsInBraces = 0;
        int maxWordLength = 0;

        boolean inBraces = false;

        StringBuilder currentWord = new StringBuilder();

        for (int index = 0; index < totalChars; index++) {
            char currentChar = inputLine.charAt(index);

            if (currentChar == '_') {
                processWord(currentWord, inBraces, (w) -> {

                    }
                });
                currentWord = new StringBuilder();

                processWord(currentWord, inBraces, (w) -> {
                    if (w > 0) {
                        if (inBraces) {
                            totalWordsInBraces++;
                        } else {
                            maxWordLength = Math.max(maxWordLength, w);
                        }
                    }
                });
                currentWord = new StringBuilder();
                inBraces = true;
            } else if (currentChar == ')') {
                processWord(currentWord, inBraces, (w) -> {
                    if (w > 0) {
                        if (inBraces) {
                            totalWordsInBraces++;
                        } else {
                            maxWordLength = Math.max(maxWordLength, w);
                        }
                    }
                });
                currentWord = new StringBuilder();
                inBraces = false;
            } else if (Character.isLetter(currentChar)) {
                currentWord.append(currentChar);
            }
        }

        processWord(currentWord, inBraces, (w) -> {
            if (w > 0) {
                if (inBraces) {
                    totalWordsInBraces++;
                } else {
                    maxWordLength = Math.max(maxWordLength, w);
                }
            }
        });

        System.out.println(maxWordLength + " " + totalWordsInBraces);
    }

    private static void processWord(StringBuilder word, boolean inBraces, java.util.function.IntConsumer consumer) {
        int length = word.length();
        if (length > 0) {
            consumer.accept(length);
        }
    }
}
